  assign s_axi_wready = 1;
  assign m_axi_wdata = {3{s_axi_wdata}};
  assign m_axi_wstrb = {3{s_axi_wstrb}};
  assign m_axi_wvalid = {3{s_axi_wvalid}};

  // AXI Write Response Channel
  assign s_axi_bresp = m_axi_bresp[1:0]; // Just taking first response for example
  assign s_axi_bvalid = m_axi_bvalid[0]; // Just taking first valid for example
  assign m_axi_bready = {3{s_axi_bready}};

  // AXI Read Address Channel
  assign s_axi_arready = 1;
  assign m_axi_araddr = {3{s_axi_araddr}};
  assign m_axi_arprot = {3{s_axi_arprot}};
  assign m_axi_arvalid = {3{s_axi_arvalid}};

  // AXI Read Data Channel
  assign s_axi_rdata = m_axi_rdata[31:0]; // Just taking first data for example
  assign s_axi_rresp = m_axi_rresp[1:0];  // Just taking first response for example
  assign s_axi_rvalid = m_axi_rvalid[0];  // Just taking first valid for example
  assign m_axi_rready = {3{s_axi_rready}};

endmodule
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Recorded targeted variant: abstraction cap = max(15, floor(0.5 × masked-region tokens)), using the runner’s Qwen tokenizer. The gate also checks code leakage. Other campaigns keep their own settings.
